notes.read: Content rows and files, read as Studio: the app's row rules do not apply, its field rules do (owner decision 2026-10-21).
notes.write: Content rows and files, changed as Studio, including uploading, replacing and deleting objects: the app's row rules do not apply, its field rules do. Every such request is recorded.
notes.sqlEditor: The SQL editor runs as the project's owning role, so row level security does not apply to it: whoever holds sqlEditor can read and change every row (owner decision RX1).
notes.elevatedSql: Acting as the service role for data requests (the elevated mode), which only these roles may switch to. It is their default; editors and viewers act as Studio.
notes.manageUsers: The project's own users, through its auth admin API.
notes.manageBuckets: Creating, changing and deleting storage buckets. Listing them is read.
notes.manageMembers: Granting and revoking Studio roles: the one thing an admin holds over a developer.
notes.administer: Project administration through the service role: the admin API, the control plane, function administration, and any route no other permission names, so a route added later starts here.
